scriptData.label: @effect.name
Torn Leg Muscle (Major)

description.label: Description
description.value:
Your antagonist spears your thigh, splitting bundles of muscle fibers and tearing a large vein. Blood pours out of both the entrance and exit wounds on either side of the leg as your wrongdoer extracts his weapon.

Effects: You gain @Condition[Bleeding] (2) and suffer a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.3S4OYOZLauXctmev]{Torn Muscle (Major)}.
